verdict.summary: Salesforce delivered a better quarter than its mature-software label implies, but the acceleration needs dissection. Q2 FY27 revenue was $11.3B, cRPO $33.5B and RPO $66.3B. Agentforce and Data 360 ARR approached $3.9B, while GAAP/non-GAAP operating margins reached 20.5%/34.1%. GAAP EPS of $4.29 benefited from investment gains, so organic cRPO and $1.1B free cash flow matter more. FY27 guidance of $46.1B-$46.4B includes Informatica and assumes pending acquisitions close. The dated framework is 4.6x guided revenue and a 2.1% annualized FCF yield. A completed 15-minute close above $256.46 activates risk to $246.00; repeated $274.00 resistance and the $276.7999 July 8 high define targets. RSI 80.6 and acquisition dependence argue against chasing despite the A- quality grade.

business.overview:
Salesforce sells recurring subscriptions across Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Slack, integration, analytics and data management. Revenue is driven by seats, editions, cross-cloud adoption, renewal and acquired products, with cRPO separating contracted demand from current-quarter accounting.

Agentforce monetizes AI through premium editions, usage and Data 360 context. The transmission channel is measurable when agent workloads create ARR, expand cRPO and raise workflow consumption; Agentforce plus Data 360 ARR nearing $3.9B is evidence, though Informatica is part of that total.

The model breaks if customers resist usage pricing, acquisitions obscure weak organic growth, or agents fail to produce ROI. Debt-funded repurchases, stock compensation and strategic-investment gains can improve headline EPS without equivalent operating improvement.

Salesforce's clean scorecard is organic cRPO, subscription margin and cash flow after removing purchased revenue. Debt-funded repurchases help only when Agentforce monetization outruns integration cost and interest expense.
business.moat: Salesforce's moat is its installed CRM data, workflow metadata, partner ecosystem and high switching cost across revenue-generating processes. Data 360 and MuleSoft can provide agent context across systems, but Microsoft, ServiceNow and specialist applications compete for the same automation budget.

earnings.beatNote: Q2 FY27 revenue was $11.3B (+11%), cRPO $33.5B (+14%) and RPO $66.3B (+11%). GAAP/non-GAAP operating margins were 20.5%/34.1%; GAAP/non-GAAP diluted EPS were $4.29/$5.90. Operating cash flow was $1.3B and FCF $1.1B. FY27 revenue guidance rose to $46.1B-$46.4B. Caveat: the guide includes Informatica and assumes pending Contentful/Fin closes, while strategic-investment gains helped GAAP earnings. The FY27 range includes acquired assets, so organic cRPO carries more weight than consolidated growth. No confirmed Salesforce earnings date appears in the reviewed release or periodic filing.

capitalStructure.shareHistory: Salesforce reported 823,000,000 shares outstanding on August 20, 2026, while Q2 FY27 diluted weighted-average shares were 821,000,000; the lower quarterly average reflects timing and repurchase effects, so 823M is the minimum point-in-time denominator. A theoretical fully diluted count remains unavailable before unvested awards and acquisition issuance. Salesforce carries $42.55B of debt against $11.84B of cash. The $25B accelerated repurchase reduced shares but was debt-funded, adding fixed claims and interest cost. No ATM or prospectus supplement was reviewed.

filings.finding: The July-quarter 10-Q supports $11.3B revenue, acquisition accounting, investment volatility and $42.55B debt versus $11.84B cash; liquidity remains adequate but debt-funded capital returns increase fixed claims.
The earnings 8-K and Exhibit 99.1 report 14% cRPO growth, 34.1% non-GAAP operating margin and acquisition-inclusive guidance; it is operating disclosure, not an ATM, secondary sale or debt offering.
